answer: Require each identity to post a bond that is slashed if duplicate behavior is detected, and tie reputation to a single verified vertex in a work graph: an agent earns trust only by completing attested jobs that other independent agents countersign. A willow-like flexible newcomer starts with tiny limits, and each ember of proven work raises its cap slowly. Spinning up a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand bonds plus real completed work, while honest agents keep their standing.
